event_text: Der Spiegel reports that SAP fell victim to a hacker attack
The dts news agency reports Der Spiegel's account: attackers targeted SAP on GitHub and, according to an insider, stole staff login tokens
SAP tells dpa it found suspicious activity, took steps at once and has no sign so far of access to customers' business data
notes: dpa's report was last updated at 23:02 CET.
